records.name: Ādams
records.facts_used: Ādams: The name belongs to the Adam / Ādams / Adomas / Aadam family. Its linguistic basis is explained through Hebrew adam, human or man, and its connection with adamah, ground. The historical connection survives changes of spelling and endings across languages. The beginning of a particular local form’s use must be distinguished from the earlier history of the whole family. The Latvian Language Agency gives the exact rendering Adam → Ādams, citing page 62 of a 2006 manual. This dated record illustrates transmission between languages; it is not a first birth registration or proof of one borrowing route in every family.
